message: Vector Rebel 3.2.58 defaults SCBA airpack results to proposed Present / Working and queues one native inspection for every selected airpack.
releaseNotes: SCBA Airpacks defaults all discovered SCBA frames to proposed Present / Working, with individually editable Issue / Missing / Not checked outcomes. After the operator confirms physical inspection, Start SCBA Checks queues every matched airpack and opens each asset's native Start Inspection in the same browser tab, one at a time. After the operator completes and submits an official native inspection, a confirmation control advances to the next airpack. This queue does not choose an unverified Standard SCBA template or auto-submit any inspection; operator confirmations are tracked separately from official Vector completion receipts.
